title: Specialist– Global Sourcing & Category Expert (Tier 2)

Sourcing & Category Management
NG Hubs Poland is hiring!

for specialist:7100 - 16600PLN

Are you ready for a new challenge in Procurement? We’re building a brand-new team in ING Hubs Poland to support Global Procurement team and looking for experienced professionals who want to work globally while staying connected locally.
We are looking for several senior experts in different IT procurement fields: Software and SaaS, Hardware (Servers, Storage, Workplaces, Network, Data Centre equipment) and IT Services.
We are looking for you if you:
Master degree or equivalent preferably in a relevant field, such as supply chain, (computer) engineering, business administration, or finance
Master degree or equivalent preferably in a relevant field, such as supply chain, (computer) engineering, business administration, or finance

Are experienced subject matter expert in strategic sourcing and category management in IT Procurement in at least one of the domains ofSoftware and SaaS, Hardware (Servers, Storage, Workplaces, Network, Data Centre equipment) and IT Services
Are experienced subject matter expert in strategic sourcing and category management in IT Procurement in at least one of the domains ofSoftware and SaaS, Hardware (Servers, Storage, Workplaces, Network, Data Centre equipment) and IT Services
